en: Schema 1.0 descriptive_summary used incorrect survival censoring names (left/right swapped vs. episode truncation) and marked episodes in-week via point timestamps instead of interval overlap with [2026-11-10, 2026-11-17].
comparable_hash_retry_episodes inferred retries from a single headRefOid at fetch; merge_group head SHA is a composite test commit and must not be treated as enqueue-head evidence.
Observer coverage mixed distinct PRs with queue admissions; corrected counts are TypeScript 43 PRs / 44 enqueues and cargo 40 / 56 (83 / 100 combined) over 8 calendar days.
GraphQL NOT_FOUND outcomes for unissued PR numbers were logged as generic fetch_failures; they are now classified separately from transport errors.
merge_group run alignment now requires workflow created_at inside the episode interval and flags temporal ambiguity explicitly.
zh: 1.0 版 descriptive_summary 的生存删失标签有误（与队列截断混淆），且用时间点而非与观察周区间的重叠判定“在周内”。
comparable_hash_retry_episodes 不能从抓取时的单一 headRefOid 推断重试；merge_group 的 head SHA 为复合测试提交，不能当作入队 head 证据。
观察者覆盖率须区分“去重 PR 数”与“入队次数”；修正后为 TypeScript 43/44、cargo 40/56（合计 83/100），观察历 8 天含首尾。
未创建 PR 编号的 GraphQL NOT_FOUND 应与传输类失败分开统计。
merge_group 对齐仅限工作流 created_at 落在 episode 区间内，并显式标注时间歧义。
